definitions.explanation: The act of doing something to pass idle time, or an activity done for that purpose. Can have a slightly casual or self-deprecating nuance.

examples.japanese: {暇|ひま}つぶしにゲームをした。
examples.english: I played games to kill time.

examples.japanese: {暇|ひま}つぶしに{本屋|ほんや}をぶらぶらした。
examples.english: I wandered around the bookstore to pass the time.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}の{中|なか}での{暇|ひま}つぶしにスマホで{動画|どうが}を{見|み}ることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: I often watch videos on my phone to kill time on the train.

notes:
USAGE:
A common casual expression. Can be used both as a noun ({暇|ひま}つぶしにする = to do something to kill time) and as a descriptive phrase. The kanji form {暇潰|ひまつぶ}し also exists but is less common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暇|ひま}つぶしに〜する (to do ~ to kill time)
- いい{暇|ひま}つぶしになる (to be a good way to kill time)
- {暇|ひま}つぶしの{方法|ほうほう} (ways to pass the time)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {時間|じかん}つぶし: killing time — a synonym with identical meaning
- {娯楽|ごらく}: entertainment, amusement — a more elevated term for leisure activities
